name: Seraphim Academy
source:
Hi, I'm Evelyn. Evelyn Price. Things are starting to get a little weird here... people are disappearing. People I have been... close to. But I'm getting ahead of myself, I should start at the beginning. In fact, this will start at the beginning. My arrival at Seraphim Academy, the all girls private school with the senior arts program and my idol, Imogen Frye, to teach the film program. There's a lot to get to, so settle in, this is gonna be a trippy ride. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/TrinityGames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
嗨，我是伊芙琳。伊芙琳·普莱斯。这里的事情开始变得有点奇怪……人们正在消失。我曾经……亲近的人。但我有点超前了，我应该从头开始。事实上，这还要从头说起。我来到塞拉芬学院，这是一所女子私立学校，设有高级艺术课程，我的偶像伊莫金·弗莱 (Imogen Frye) 教授电影课程。有很多事情要做，所以安顿下来，这将是一次迷幻之旅。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/TrinityGames]Patreon[/url]]
